title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on John 12: the ointment at Bethany, the palm branches in Jerusalem, and the voice from the sky.

questions.text: What did Mary do with the pound of ointment of pure nard?
questions.explanation: Mary anointed Jesus's feet and wiped his feet with her hair, and the house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

answers.text: She anointed Jesus' feet with it
She poured it over Jesus' head
She sold it and gave it to the poor
She kept it in the money box

questions.text: Who asked why the ointment was not sold for three hundred denarii?
questions.explanation: Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, asked this.

questions.text: What does the text say about Judas and the money box?
questions.explanation: He did not say it because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief who used to steal what was put into the money box.

answers.text: He truly cared for the poor
He handed it over to Martha
He was a thief and stole from it
He kept careful accounts of it

questions.text: For what day did Jesus say Mary had kept the ointment?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to leave her alone, for she had kept this for the day of his burial.

answers.text: The day of the Feast of the Dedication
The day he would be glorified

questions.text: What did the great multitude carry when they went out to meet him?
questions.explanation: They took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, crying out, "Hosanna!"

questions.text: What did Jesus sit on when he came to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it, as it is written that the King comes sitting on a donkey's colt.

answers.text: A seat carried by his disciples

questions.text: Who came to Philip and said, "Sir, we want to see Jesus"?
questions.explanation: Certain Greeks who had gone up to worship at the feast came to Philip with this request.

questions.text: What does Jesus say happens to a grain of wheat that falls into the earth and dies?
questions.explanation: He says that unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies it remains alone, but if it dies it bears much fruit.

answers.text: It is gathered into the barn

questions.text: What did some in the multitude say about the voice that came out of the sky?
questions.explanation: The multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered.

answers.text: That it was the voice of Moses
That the chief priests had shouted

questions.text: Why did many of the rulers who believed in him not confess it?
questions.explanation: Because of the Pharisees they did not confess it, so that they would not be put out of the synagogue, for they loved men's praise more than God's praise.

answers.text: They had seen no signs at all
They feared being put out of the synagogue
They were afraid of the Romans
